sessions.worktreeHelp: The daemon runs the session in a separate git checkout on a new branch (<branch>-wt) and places it under ~/.factory/worktrees on the PC; the location cannot be changed. Folders that are not git repositories open normally. The app does not remove worktrees: on the PC run `git worktree remove --force <path>` and `git branch -D <branch>-wt` in the repository when you are done.

battery.title: Battery optimisation
battery.why: Android can pause apps in the background to save battery. A paused app loses its connection to your daemon, so a running turn can stall and notifications can arrive late or not at all. Setting Droid Mobile to unrestricted prevents this.
battery.stepsTitle: How to set the app to unrestricted
battery.step2: Find Droid Mobile in the list of apps.
battery.step3: Choose "Unrestricted" or "Don't optimise" (on Samsung: Battery > Background usage limits > Never sleeping apps > add Droid Mobile).
battery.step4: Come back to this screen: the status below updates by itself.
battery.openFailed: The system settings could not be opened. Open Settings > Apps > Droid Mobile > Battery manually.
